findings: HardLine owns only two numeric half-open UTF8 byte ranges. It neither retains text nor validates direct field construction. source_range uses content.start..max(endpoints), so slicing requires the corresponding text and valid fields.

Seven actual separators are CR,LF,VT,FF,NEL,LS,PS. Scanner consumes CRLF as one separator and normally emits a terminal line even for empty source or a trailing separator. This set is independent from shaped-cache single-paragraph eligibility.

for_each_hard_line callback false returns before updating line_start and omits the terminal callback. Public crate-level visit wrapper always returns true, so it scans every line; final callback bool is intentionally unused.

hard_lines allocates all descriptions. hard_line_count scans all with saturated increments but no per-line vector. count_and_window scans all even with empty/reversed window; window alone immediately returns empty or stops at its ordinal upper bound.

Ordinal ranges select hard lines; emitted content/separator ranges are source UTF8 byte ranges. Neither window API retains source, runs shaping, enforces cache admission nor guarantees bounded peak allocation.

Navigation clamps oversized/non-boundary offsets down to a UTF8 character boundary. LF within CRLF belongs to the preceding line; hard_line_end returns CR there. next_hard_line_start checks only its clamped supplied position and does not search forward for a later separator.

Grapheme callers separately preserve grapheme column; these byte helpers do not promise grapheme boundaries or soft wrapping. Intrinsic vertical measurement separately passes hard-line count through geometry budget.

Retained index caller owns Arc source and may bypass index storage while still returning count/window. Unretained session records bypass before direct scan. Document fragment parsing removes a terminal empty line when the fragment does not reach document end.

Owned9 normal tests and1 helper contain29 fixed assertion sites. Large-input fixtures construct strings around the work-budget default; no shaping backend, resource admission or exhaustive per-separator execution is demonstrated. Zero tests executed.

Actual Python consumer uses production_code_view and checks graphics before Runtime aggregate. Local forbidden operands/editor/legacy/server counts remain zero; selected naming reader behavior and its external CR-RUNTIME-TESTS-ABS-0008 remain unchanged, without aggregate acceptance claim.
